A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adsorption of butanol from dilute solution is driven by desorption of water and that calixarenes with large upper rim groups are the most favorable adsorption sites.

the adsorption of butanol into calixarenes is enthalpically favorable and entropically favorable and that the adsorption strength can be tuned by changing the calixarenes and/or the calixarenelinked surface.

the adsorption of butanol onto tert-butylcalx[4]arenes is driven by desorption of water from the calixarenes and that the adsorption is reversible and occurs in the absence of significant enthalpic contributions.
